# Count

## Summary
A whole-number tally — things sold, sessions logged, pieces in a bundle. The block owns the display problem counts share: digit grouping at full size ("47,200") and compact notation where space is scarce ("47.2K" in the atom, full number as tooltip), with tabular numerals so columns of counts align. An explicit zero renders as a number; only null/undefined renders as the em-dash "not counted".

## Usage
```ts
import CountField from '@cardstack/catalog/fields/count/count-field';

@field ticketsSold = contains(CountField);
```
Serializes exactly like `NumberField`, so an existing count upgrades in place with no instance migration. A primitive field cannot carry inline examples, so this Spec shows a live value in full and as an atom. The Activity Log Example card (`fields/count/example/ActivityLogExample/practice-journal`) shows a large count, a moderate one and an explicit zero side by side.

## Non-goals
The block does not round or coerce — a fractional value is a writer bug the display should expose, not launder. Counting is the consumer's job (stored baseline or a computed rollup, per the decision-B rule); this block only displays the number. Quantities with units (3 kg, 2 hrs) belong to Quantity/Duration; money belongs to Money.
